headline: On last trading day, Sensex dropped 1,484 points as heavy profit-taking triggered sharp selling across sectors.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Heavy selling in banking and metal stocks led market losses on the previous session.
Investors engaged in widespread profit-booking after a four-week rally.
Investor wealth worth over Rs 5.6 lakh crore was wiped out in the market slump.
Broad-based market weakness pushed the Nifty below the key 25,350 mark.
whatHappening: Sensex plummeted 1,484 points and Nifty fell sharply during the last session.
SEBI is planning to stop market intermediaries from publishing IPO Grey Market Premium (GMP).
Mahanadi Coalfields IPO got fully subscribed on its final day of bidding.
Bisleri affirmed its packaged water is safe amid an ongoing FSSAI investigation.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian equity markets crashed with the Sensex dropping nearly 1,500 points due to heavy profit booking in banking and metal stocks. Over Rs 5.6 lakh crore of investor wealth was wiped out in the single-day slump. Markets are closed today for an NSE trading holiday and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.
